To analyze the micro-texture of the disc florets and petal edges for signs of AI smoothing, melting, or repetitive patterns.

focus_areas: Texture realism of the central yellow disc florets

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'granular' texture of the yellow center. AI often smears this into a solid yellow mass or creates repetitive, tiled patterns. Verify that the transition between the yellow disc and white petals is sharp and biologically plausible, without haloing or color bleeding. Check for any unnatural symmetry in the petal arrangement.
